Rule already exists (SHORT_RSI_HARD_FLOOR=45) — these entries were copy-trader/volume-buildup paths that need the same floor enforced.

WHY WE WEREN'T ON IT: ai-trader-pending picked counter-trend. Regime gate should veto SHORT picks when ema300_position=ABOVE and trend_quality=STRONG_UP.

P3 — MID-BAND LONGS ARE CHOP-ENTRIES (n=10 sweet-band, 50% WR, -0.25): IO LONG (RSI 57.1, trail_arm_timeout -0.08), BANANA LONG (RSI 58.3, atr_sl_hit -0.09), WLD LONG (RSI 52.6, hard_sl -0.15 — biggest 48h loss). The +0.40% trail-arm filter is the tell: if a long can't reach +0.40% within ~2h in a STRONG_UP BTC regime, the coin is dead money. Exit rule: hard-exit longs that stall below +0.10% after 2h.

P4 — SIGNAL FAMILIES DYING: volume-breakout-long+ 17.6% WR / -1.03 (17 trades); pump-chain- shorts 25.5% WR / ~flat (47 trades); bb-bounce-v2-long+ 44.4% WR / -0.49 (27 trades). All three are mean-reversion/chase hybrids failing in a trending regime. Do not increase allocation; route new risk to trend-following families (r2v2-long, continuum-trend, trend-ride) and regime-aligned ai-trader picks.
